review.reason: Exact requested 3.7 cut-off only, using explicitly limited 3.7.1 functional-reference and fixed-allocation proxy evidence. Preserve one kg wet waste-oil treatment service: both inspected incinerators and native hazardous-waste incineration describe 10 percent water. Keep two separate native treatment shares 0.397600148816246 and 0.397566014085865, original road 0.01932 and rail 0.0112 tonne-km and their marginal uncertainty. Do not renormalise to one kg of incineration, divide by dry matter or add fuel/energy/recovery credits. The remaining 0.204833837097889 kg is a clinker-kiln waste receipt with 57 zero allocated nominal exchanges and zero uncertainty bounds; all inherited formulas also occur in the nonzero clinker activity. Explicitly omit that allocated-zero receipt from the target supplier graph and retain its signed quantity and evidence in the omission audit. This is not a claim that physical co-processing or kiln emissions are zero; parameter recalculation and other allocations are not represented. Source negative waste reference becomes positive target treatment reference at factor -1; keep internal treatment/transport burdens positive. Native Swiss incineration replaces European with/without-energy-recovery variants using its complete disposal inventory, residues and allocation once. Geography, vintage, technology, uncertainty, fleet and native biosphere exclusions differ and score effects are unquantified. Requested source is not relabelled: it remains ecoinvent 3.7 cut-off. Inspected inventories are 3.7.1, not bare 3.7. Exact matching functional names, products, locations and product UUID support the previously documented limited patch-reference inference. Source quantities, allocation and omission are adopted as screening assumptions. Omission hash and original index identify the inspected patch proxy witness only, not a directly inspected bare-3.7 vector; no cross-version inventory or score equality is asserted.
